title: Faint negative sketch of elongated ribbed cigar-shaped object on hotel stationery
description: Low-contrast photostat negative of a vertically oriented sketch of an elongated spindle- or cigar-shaped object divided by horizontal cross-bands, with lines fanning out from its lower end and a small oval at lower left. Faint reversed hotel letterhead ("HENRY GRADY HOTEL") and indistinct handwriting are visible in the background.
